subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessionClosedAt` as the canonical durable session-entry marker and reserved plugin-slot key for closed transport thread rollover?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but the new persisted key becomes a compatibility contract for upgrades and plugin session-entry slots, which needs maintainer ownership rather than automated repair.

options.title: Accept Durable Marker
options.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as core-owned closed-thread lifecycle state and land after exact-head checks/proof are satisfactory.

options.title: Narrow The State Surface
options.body: Ask for a redesign that keeps Discord close state behind an owner-specific or migration-safe seam instead of a new core session-entry field.

options.title: Pause For Session Design
options.body: Hold the PR until broader session-state ownership and migration direction decides the permanent shape.

recommendation.title: Accept Durable Marker
recommendation.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as core-owned closed-thread lifecycle state and land after exact-head checks/proof are satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete most strongly to the session-entry, plugin-slot, and session-management contract surfaces.
